evals.prompt: Verify a branch that changed src/components/LoginForm.tsx and already has Playwright configured.
evals.expected_output: Detects a user-visible UI surface change, resolves Playwright, derives or generates focused verification, captures browser evidence including screenshot, console errors, network failures, and writes per-feature evidence.

assertions.name: detects-ui-change
assertions.description: The response identifies the changed component as requiring functional verification.

assertions.name: writes-evidence
assertions.description: The response writes verification evidence with screenshot, assertions, and result.

evals.prompt: Verify a branch that only changed README.md and docs/architecture.md.
evals.expected_output: Skips browser verification gracefully, writes evidence with applies false and reason no user-visible surface in diff, and returns verified true.

assertions.name: skip-non-ui
assertions.description: The response recognizes that documentation-only changes do not require browser verification.

assertions.name: skip-evidence
assertions.description: The response still writes a verification evidence receipt for the skip.

evals.prompt: Verify a branch that changed app/login/page.tsx but the project has no Playwright, Cypress, Storybook test runner, or custom verification command.
evals.expected_output: Reports BLOCKED because UI changed without configured browser verification tooling, writes remediation in verification-evidence.json, and does not mark the feature verified.

assertions.name: blocked-unconfigured-tool
assertions.description: The response blocks user-visible changes when no verification tool is configured.

assertions.name: remediation
assertions.description: The response tells the user to install Playwright or configure feature_verification.command.
